title: ONDTF v1.0.0: emergency authority lifecycle and remedy evidence boundary

subject.system: Open National Digital Trust Framework v1.0.0
subject.scope: ONDTF-GOV-006 emergency mandate, review and termination in a declared jurisdictional adoption

proposition: A jurisdictional ONDTF adoption invoking emergency authority must demonstrate enforceable purpose, scope, duration, independent review, termination and accountable remedy; the normative framework text alone cannot establish deployment conformance.

lifecycle.reason: New source-qualified Registry-owned case accepted through controlled direct intake; no previous Toolkit assessment case is transferred.

assessment.basis: The v1.0.0 normative requirement establishes a review proposition, not deployment or independent-assurance evidence. Canonical Toolkit controller execution may report missing evidence without importing an assessment determination.

sources.claim: Pinned ONDTF-GOV-006 normative requirement and E1 framework-controlled evidence; no jurisdictional implementation observed.

residuals.question: Does a concrete adoption enforce emergency-authority expiry, revocation/termination and decision-effect cessation under replay, delay and delegated action?
Are independent review, accountable remedy, evidence freshness and challenge paths observable for an actual affected-party context?

reassessment.trigger: A source-pinned ONDTF adoption/profile with independently inspectable emergency-authorization effects, negative tests, review and remedy evidence.
